ns0:entry.ns0:title: [Jeff Su]Most people get these 3 AI terms wrong

ns2:group.ns2:title: Most people get these 3 AI terms wrong
ns2:group.ns2:description:
#AI hallucination is the flip side of creativity. That's the first of three terms most people misunderstand.
Term 1: Hallucination. The same mechanism that produces wrong answers is what generates creative writing, ideas, and novel connections. The real question is whether your task needs creativity or accuracy. Turning off web search in #ChatGPT or Claude gives you more creativity. Turning it on gives you more accuracy.
Term 2: Context window. Think of it as a fixed-size whiteboard. Once it's full, the AI drops older information to fit new input. If your AI starts giving weird answers mid-conversation, just start a new chat.
Term 3: Tokens. This is why free plans have usage limits. AI breaks your words into chunks called tokens, and every chunk costs usage. Better prompts mean fewer tokens, so you get more out of your plan before hitting the cap.

停經後女姓開始出現脂肪肝怎麼辦？
時間標示： 0:00 雞蛋對停經後女性的好處 0:05 蛋黃和膽鹼 (choline) 0:55 為什麼膽鹼對停經後婦女有益？ 1:27 補充雌激素 1:40 膽鹼和脂肪肝 2:00 膽鹼的劑量和來源
柏格醫生 dr berg 談：蛋對於停經後女性，很重要。
蛋黃含豐富的膽鹼 (choline)。 膽鹼是有助於去除肝脂肪的維生素，可預防脂肪肝。 缺膽鹼，可能更容易患上脂肪肝。 膽鹼還能幫助分解脂質，生成膽鹽，分解脂肪。 缺膽鹼會導致便秘、影響記憶力。
膽鹼可能對停經後婦女有幫助，因為更年期，雌激素較少，雌激素可以防止膽鹼的流失。

麵包的真正危險，不是麩質。揭露麵包不健康的原因，它如何影響胰島素和血糖，及戒麵包後，可吃什麼來代替。
時間標示 0:00 麵包的真正危險，不是麩質 1:14 麵包最大問題 1:59 無麩質產品用什麼取代小麥？ 3:27 人們大量吃這類食物的後果 4:37 嚼麵包時，澱粉分解為糖 6:11 糖化現象 7:05 "全麥較健康"是誤解 8:22 現代小麥 9:08 麵包上癮，戒不掉，怎麼辦？
柏格醫生 dr berg 談：麵包幾乎都是澱粉，澱粉是葡萄糖鏈，就算標示0克糖，澱粉也會迅速在血中分解為糖。
人們常吃到小麥，包括披薩、麥片、"健康"燕麥棒等。一般美國人，幾乎每天吃到小麥。
麵包最大問題，是飆升血糖，就算標榜”零糖”，也可能比砂糖更迅速飆升血糖。
無麩質產品用什麼取代小麥？ 1.馬鈴薯澱粉，和小麥澱粉一樣糟 2.米粉 3.木薯澱粉 4.玉米澱粉
全是工業澱粉，是葡萄糖鏈，造成相同影響，只是無麩質。所以，無麩質麵包，並非總是更健康的選擇。
麵包等澱粉食品，讓血糖暴衝，影響低密度脂蛋白(LDL)。
人們大量吃這類食品的後果： 1.高血糖 2.脂肪肝 3.糖化現象
吃麵包，飆升血糖後，胰島素進來，快速移掉糖。糖去哪了？被存到肝，或存成腹部脂肪。長期飆升胰島素，細胞無法控制胰島素並開始抗拒，稱胰島素阻抗。
麩質只影響少數人，澱粉(隱藏糖)才影響多數人 。現代小麥，雜交改良過，麩質更多，讓麵包有彈性，但也帶來問題。

ns2:group.ns2:title: This mistake made a Labubu “lose face”
ns2:group.ns2:description:
A Labubu keychain turned into a “faceless doll” after being wiped with nail polish remover, highlighting potential material risks with collectible toys.
A consumer in Henan told Jiemian News that after noticing stains, they used a remover wipe to clean the figure — only to find its facial features completely erased. The Labubu, purchased earlier this year, was later discarded.
Customer service from Pop Mart said plush keychains should be cleaned gently with an eraser or alcohol-free wipes. Products like nail polish remover, detergents, or alcohol-based cleaners are not recommended, as they may damage the surface.
The main ingredients in nail polish remover — acetone or ethyl acetate — can dissolve or deform materials such as PVC and polyester, commonly used in Labubu products.

ns2:group.ns2:title: Trump pauses Iran strike plan for two weeks
ns2:group.ns2:description:
The U.S. has agreed to pause planned military action against Iran for two weeks, following a request from Pakistan, according to Chinese state media. U.S. President Donald Trump said the pause is conditional on Iran ensuring safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
Washington said it had received a 10-point proposal from Iran and viewed it as a basis for negotiations. The White House added that Israel has agreed to a temporary ceasefire, signaling a broader de-escalation effort.
Iran’s Supreme National Security Council later said it accepted Pakistan’s ceasefire proposal, with talks set for April 10 in Islamabad to finalize details. The proposal includes controlled access through the strait, an end to attacks on Iran and its allies, and a withdrawal of U.S. forces from Gulf bases.
Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said the ceasefire took effect at 8 a.m. Beijing time.
